# Deliberate Directions

> Business coaching and executive coaching firm in Boise offering mastermind groups, leadership development, and strategic growth programs for business owners and C-suite executives.

Deliberate Directions is a Boise-based business growth firm founded by Allison Dunn that specializes in coaching, mastermind groups (Whetstone), and group training programs. The firm also operates an event venue (Owyhee Penthouse) and produces the Deliberate Leaders Podcast featuring CEO interviews and business strategy insights.
